title: Umgcini weLangatye Elingacimiyo
intro: Umntu umi emnyango wendawo eyoyikekayo kwindawo engabonakaliyo, enikwe umsebenzi ongenakufiswa ngomnye umntu. Xa imiphefumlo ebandezelekileyo ikhala icela inceba, impendulo eqatha ivakala emagumbini omlilo. Ungamtyhila na lo mlondolozi waphakade?
clues: Ndimi emnyango wendawo eyoyikekayo yesohlwayo kwindawo engabonakaliyo.
Umlilo ovuthayo, ongacimiyo ngowona uphambili kumsebenzi wam obalulekileyo.
Imiphefumlo ebandezelekileyo ibiza igama lam, icela ukukhululeka kwintlungu yayo engapheliyo.
Xa becela uxolo, ndithi abayi kuphinda bamshiye.
Andingomntu, andingoJinn — ndingumntu odalwe ngokuthobela okumsulwa.
Ndingungelosi eyintloko emiselwe ukuba ngumlindi waphakade wesihogo somlilo.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Abantu baseSihogweni bacela ukuba intlungu yabo iphele
Umprofeti uphoswa emlilweni omkhulu ngabantu bakhe
Udonga oluqinileyo lwakhiwe ukuze luthintele isizwe esonakeleyo
trial.answer: Abantu baseSihogweni bacela ukuba intlungu yabo iphele

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Abemi besiHogo baxelelwa ukuba baya kuhlala ngonaphakade
Abemi besiHogo banikwa ithuba lesibini lokukholwa
outcome.answer: Abemi besiHogo baxelelwa ukuba baya kuhlala ngonaphakade

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
